geom_hline(yintercept = simudata$constants$amy_thresh * 169.27 - 102.35, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
xlab("Positivity Age (years)") +
ylab("Amyloid (CL)") +
theme_bw() +
theme(legend.position = "none") + annotate(
"text",
x = max(dta2$age_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE) - 2,
y = simudata$constants$amy_thresh * 169.27 - 102.35,
label = "A+ CL = 24",
vjust = -0.6,
size = 3
) + geom_ribbon(data = plot_data_amy_pred,
aes(x = da, ymin = fp_lci, ymax = fp_uci),inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.4) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy_pred, aes(x = da, y = fp_lci), color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy_pred, aes(x = da, y = fp_uci), color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
geom_line(data = plot_data_amy_pred, aes(x = da, y = fp),
linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3, 75))+ scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-20, 15))
